entry.title: Gerbrandy Tower
entry.note: Native +X east, +Z south. Round shaft has no principal horizontal axis; mapped asymmetric guy-anchor positions provide actual orientation. Anchor is the exact-QID circular shaft center. The three guy blocks use their actual surveyed footprint positions, not a symmetric invented triangle. Guy attachment heights other than the published 226 m level are reconstructed from current contractor photographs; all local geometry shares the concrete shaft terrain-contact datum. Surrounding polder is nearly flat; detailed foundation grading remains approximate. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
